scope: Synthetic retrospective monthly operating trajectory and bidirectional alert backtest; not an official health score, cash stock, default probability or causal diagnosis

source.binding_rule: Resolve this relative artifact inside the pinned run, never through a mutable current pointer or a new build
source.perimeter: booked checking/saving/wallet; bounded operating EUR flows; verified conversions only; not full company accounts
source.raw_policy: Immutable; no raw reads or rebuild required by this contract
source.availability: available_at = last_day(month); require every contributing row available_at <= as_of; retrospective assumption, not certified historical known_on
source.row_policy: Retain every company x calendar month, including absent/ineligible months with nulls and explicit reasons; never compress gaps or impute zero
source.identity_checks: Unique company/month and stable company/group; reject unexpected schema, keys or hashes before outcome access

monthly_state.name: deficit_state
monthly_state.eligibility: Present closed month, cash activity true, n_sin_eur=0, finite gross>0, finite ordered lower/upper operating bounds in base AND trim
monthly_state.rounding_for_state_only: Round bounds to EUR cents half-away-from-zero, as v1 robust_deficit
monthly_state.deficit: Rounded upper<0 in base AND trim
monthly_state.non_deficit: Rounded lower>=0 in base AND trim
monthly_state.otherwise: insufficient_evidence; retain reasons for gaps, activity, FX, gross, bounds, ambiguity or trim disagreement
monthly_state.separation: Deficit is a level, not deterioration; non_deficit is not improvement; no quality penalty or 0-100 score

direction.input_eligibility: All six contiguous calendar months pass monthly input eligibility; a robust deficit/non_deficit classification is NOT required
direction.ratios: For each variant, lower/gross and upper/gross; use the same observed base gross for base AND trim; no invented trimmed denominator
direction.aggregation: Unweighted arithmetic means of monthly ratios, NOT ratio of sums
direction.threshold_unit: 5 percentage points of gross; fixed design decision, not optimised
direction.stable: Entire delta interval strictly inside (-0.05,0.05) in base AND trim
direction.otherwise: insufficient_evidence; reason ambiguous_direction or input eligibility reasons; never relabel uncertainty as stable
direction.comparison_precision: Finite binary64 arithmetic; chronological sums divided by 3; no display rounding, cents rounding or epsilon before direction comparisons
direction.explanation: Show recent/prior known operating in/gross and out/gross, base/trim intervals and delta; delta identified net ratio = delta in ratio - delta out ratio
direction.explanation_limits: Known-flow arithmetic, not SHAP, causal attribution, model points or a decomposition of uncertainty bounds; keep denominator changes and unknown classification visible

alerts.candidate: First directional month is provisional watch; second consecutive calendar month of same sign emits one confirmed alert at that second month-end; no more alerts in that run
alerts.baseline: One alert at first directional month of each same-sign episode; no persistence; comparison only
alerts.run_break: Stable, insufficient_evidence, missing month or opposite sign ends the previous run; opposite sign starts a new run immediately
alerts.history_initialisation: Process chronologically from calendar start using only past/current rows; carry run state across period boundaries, never restart an ongoing episode to create an evaluation alert
alerts.dates: Store first_signal_at separately from confirmed_alert_at; issue at actual month-end, never backdate confirmation to watch

events.unit: company + sign + onset_month; built only from robust monthly deficit_state, independent of direction, alerts and probabilities
events.deterioration: non_deficit at s-2,s-1 then deficit at s,s+1
events.improvement: deficit at s-2,s-1 then non_deficit at s,s+1
events.onset: Month s, first month of new state
events.confirmation: last_day(s+1); all four contiguous states observed and robust by confirmation
events.gap_rule: Any missing/insufficient state makes the pattern unknown, not a no-event
events.recovered_dip_demo_only: non_deficit at s-2,s-1; deficit at s; non_deficit at s+1,s+2; recovery confirmed last_day(s+2), not backdated; not a sustained event target

evaluation.exclusion_scope: Exclude ALL v1 final_test groups before development, event detection, alert evaluation or case selection at ANY date; never rerun v1 test
evaluation.product_only_exception: Their observed as-of trajectories may be displayed without event labels, matching or outcome-based selection; no reserved outcome inspection before the one-shot evaluation
evaluation.independence: Temporal reserve on known companies; NOT a new independent group holdout or external validation; shared synthetic corpus and upstream preparation limit independence
evaluation.lead_definition: Calendar month difference onset - actual issued alert origin; not time to confirmation; no zero or negative lead credited
evaluation.event_denominator: Confirmed event within outcome cutoff with at least one direction-input-eligible origin in its [s-2,s-1] window AND the specified alert-origin period; independent of sign prediction and persistence
evaluation.same_denominator: Use the same eligible observed events for candidate and baseline; do not require that an alert was possible under that method's run state
evaluation.matching: Separately per method, company and sign: sort issued alerts by origin; match each to earliest unmatched eligible future event with lead 1 or 2; each alert/event used at most once
evaluation.ties: Sort by company_id, sign and month; reject duplicate identities; no score-based tie breaking
evaluation.unmatched_alert: false_alarm only with complete follow-up; otherwise censored_unknown; an extra alert does not disappear because another alert matched that event
evaluation.complete_followup: For alert origin o, every monthly state from o-1 through o+3 must be observed and robust and last_day(o+3)<=outcome cutoff; covers both possible onsets and their prior/confirmation months
evaluation.matched_with_other_gaps: A fully observed matched event suffices for a match even if other months in the alert follow-up are unknown; disclose coverage separately
evaluation.miss: Eligible observed event with no matched alert for that method; unknown event patterns are not misses or negatives
evaluation.left_censoring: Require s-2,s-1 history for an event and six-month history for eligible origins; report exclusions and pre-period alert episodes, never shift an issue date into the period
evaluation.right_censoring: Require event confirmation and full o+3 follow-up for an unmatched alert to be false; immature windows stay censored_unknown
evaluation.coverage: Report all company/origin opportunities, direction-input-eligible and ineligible origins/reasons, fully observed and unknown event windows, event exclusions without an eligible origin and alerts with incomplete follow-up; no filling unknowns or selecting denominators by success
evaluation.no_prediction_comparison: p_proxy predicts target_deficit_3m, not these transitions; no event-performance metrics for v1 probabilities

reporting.strata: Development and reserve separately; improvement and deterioration separately; candidate and baseline separately
reporting.lead_time: Matched events only: counts at 1 and 2 calendar months and median; no lead claim when no matches
reporting.zero_denominator: null plus explicit reason, never zero or invented estimate

bootstrap.support: At least 5 observed eligible events across at least 5 event-bearing groups per sign/period; additionally at least 5 denominator-contributing groups for each metric/method
bootstrap.unit: Sample all 200 included groups with replacement, preserving all companies and chronology within each sampled group copy; shared draws for candidate/baseline, no row bootstrap or new fits
bootstrap.interval: 95% percentile, linear quantiles 0.025/0.975; report support and number of finite/undefined replicates for each metric
bootstrap.undefined_replicates: No redraw; use defined replicates only if at least 950/1000 are finite, otherwise CI null with reason; disclose conditioning on defined replicates
bootstrap.low_support: Descriptive counts/rates only, label insufficient support; no uncertainty or superiority claim

reporting.success_policy: Measure honestly; no required improvement, recall, lead or false-alert threshold and no tuning on reserve

v1_probability_overlay.eligibility: Original v1 features and prospective input eligibility, same order and sealed model; inputs through each origin only; no new fit or calibration
v1_probability_overlay.before_cutoff_or_ineligible: p_proxy null with reason; never backcast, interpolate or pad the 24-month curve
v1_probability_overlay.display: Separate retrospective uncalibrated probability of target_deficit_3m with horizon m+1..m+3 and model/input versions; never a 0-100 health score or a direction label
v1_probability_overlay.limits: Model physically trained in September 2026; April-August is an as-of simulation under the retrospective availability assumption, not proof of live historical issuance

demo_cases.source: Development groups and development outcomes only, confirmed no later than 2025-12-31; never reserved v2 or final_test v1
demo_cases.selection: Per type use the earliest confirmed qualifying pattern with onset in the development lead-window union and at least one eligible development origin; break ties by company_id then onset; do not rank by alert match, probability or outcome magnitude
demo_cases.absence: If none exists, report unavailable; no substituted reserved case or fabricated real-data example
demo_cases.dates: Show state, direction, watch, actual confirmation and retrospective event confirmation as distinct facts; development dates have no v1 probability overlay

preservation.protocol: Exclusive immutable file before any event/outcome backtest; existing different bytes block; amendments require a new version before reserve inspection
preservation.execution_manifest: Later manifest binds protocol hash, implementation code, input/assignment/model hashes, environment, outputs and results; no results invented in this contract
preservation.reserved_access: Exclusive persisted receipt tied to protocol and code hashes before reserved outcome access; one evaluation; after interruption inspect receipt and existing outputs, never blind replay or delete receipt
preservation.frozen_assets: No modification of raw/runs/marts, v1 scripts/tests, protocol-v1, experiment-v1 or assessment-v1; no new fits or v1 target evaluation
preservation.workflow: Runtime task state, retry budgets and goal tracking are not protocol fields
